title.en: NPA energy-bin and spectral-flux increment record

summary: Replay the stateless scalar slice of store_npa: convert one neutral-particle velocity to keV, select the nearest energy channel with the source's first-of-tie minloc, cap the orbit class by the available class count, and return the non-accumulated flux/dE record for the caller's own (energy, detector, class) storage.

identity.relation: energy = beam_mass * v2_to_E_per_amu * dot(v, v); dE = energy_grid(2) - energy_grid(1) (the source's first-adjacent-center convention, not the local cell width); the channel is Fortran minloc(abs(energy_grid - energy)) one-based with the first channel winning ties; the class record is min(orbit_class, nclass); the returned spectral increment is flux/dE, non-accumulated.
identity.direction: one neutral velocity + beam mass + velocity-to-energy conversion + the caller's active/passive energy centers + detector/orbit-class/class-count indices + one hit flux -> one non-accumulated {energy, energy bin, detector, capped class, flux/dE} record
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM NPA能量通道通量增量 operator (source anchor src/fidasim.f90:10600-10724, the scalar part of store_npa): it reads and mutates no storage -- the caller owns the (energy, detector, class) accumulator, the active/passive grid choice, coordinate transforms, hit production and the whole NPA Monte Carlo. The saved bundle's ledger additionally records a native source microprobe (npa_store_flux_audit against frozen source 9019e945...) claiming three real store_npa replays with max_abs = 0; that evidence directory is outside the frozen saved input and could not be re-verified byte-wise, so SciRel's review ceiling for this integration remains the package-level equation/boundary oracle plus the historical ledger claim, not re-verified Fortran runtime parity.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with registered integer/boolean/spacing/increment hardenings
identity.geometry: one hit record; no spatial geometry -- the caller owns hit production and storage
identity.coordinates: velocity in cm/s (axis order x,y,z); masses in amu; energies in keV; the conversion constant in keV/(amu*(cm/s)^2); flux in neutrals/s; increments in neutrals/(s*keV); bin and class indices are one-based exactly as in the source
identity.boundary: finite 3-vector velocity; positive finite mass and conversion; finite nonnegative flux; finite strictly increasing energy centers with at least two entries and a positive finite first spacing dE; positive genuine integers for the detector, orbit class and class count; the computed energy and the returned increment must be finite; no accumulator access, no xyz_to_uvw reconstruction, no get_fields pitch, no OpenMP/MPI and no whole-program replay
assumptions: The caller selects the active or passive NPA energy grid and accumulates the returned record itself; this leaf is stateless.
The first adjacent center pair defines dE even on non-uniform grids and for hits binned far from the first two centers, exactly as in the source.

inputs.name: velocity_cm_s
inputs.constraints: Finite shape-(3,); boolean entries rejected in container, bool dtype and object form before numpy coercion (registered hardening; a bool already lost inside a constructed float64 array is not recoverable).

inputs.name: beam_mass_amu
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive (booleans rejected -- registered hardening).

inputs.name: velocity_squared_to_energy_per_amu_kev_s2_cm_minus2
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive (booleans rejected -- registered hardening).

inputs.name: energy_centers_kev
inputs.description: The caller's active or passive NPA energy centers (source energy_grid).
inputs.constraints: Finite and strictly increasing; boolean entries rejected in container, bool dtype and object form (registered hardening); the first adjacent spacing must be a positive finite float (r81 repair).

inputs.name: detector_index_one_based
inputs.description: The caller's detector channel number (source detector index, passed through).
inputs.constraints: A genuine positive integer (np.integer accepted; bools rejected -- registered hardening: the saved arm's isinstance(value, int) also rejected whole-number floats and np.integer, so float rejection is continuity).

inputs.name: orbit_class_one_based
inputs.description: The hit's orbit class number (source orbit_class).
inputs.constraints: A genuine positive integer; capped by class_count in the output.

inputs.name: class_count
inputs.description: The number of orbit classes available for this detector (source nclass).

inputs.name: flux_neutrals_per_s
inputs.description: The single hit's flux after the caller's N8 hit/attenuation/geometry reductions.
inputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative (booleans rejected -- registered hardening).

outputs.name: energy_kev
outputs.description: The particle energy beam_mass * v2_to_E_per_amu * dot(v, v).
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; an overflowing velocity/mass product fails closed (registered hardening).

outputs.name: energy_bin_one_based
outputs.description: The one-based nearest energy channel, first channel on exact ties (source minloc).

outputs.name: detector_index_one_based
outputs.description: The detector channel number, passed through verbatim.

outputs.name: class_index_one_based
outputs.description: The orbit class capped by class_count (source min(orbit_class, nclass)).

outputs.name: spectral_flux_increment_per_kev
outputs.description: The non-accumulated flux/dE increment (source flux/dE with dE = grid(2) - grid(1)).
outputs.constraints: Finite and nonnegative; a subnormal or overflowing first spacing or a non-finite quotient fails closed (r81 repair: the saved arm returned inf for dE = 5e-324 and silent 0.0 when dE overflowed).

preconditions: The caller supplies the energy grid, indices and one hit's flux; the record is accumulated by the caller.
supported: One stateless store_npa scalar record: energy, nearest bin (first-of-tie), detector passthrough, class cap and flux/dE increment.
excluded: The global NPA accumulator, xyz_to_uvw and get_fields pitch reconstruction, hit/attenuation production, OpenMP/MPI reduction, HDF5 writers and whole-program replay.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when the velocity is not a finite boolean-free 3-vector, when the centers are not finite boolean-free strictly increasing with a positive finite first spacing, when mass/conversion are not positive finite or the flux negative or boolean, when any index is not a genuine positive integer, or when the computed energy or the flux/dE increment is not finite (r81 repairs).
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Not applicable; bounded arithmetic over the declared contracts.
failure_semantics.partial_results: Never returned; the caller's storage is never touched.

scope: Saved-package oracles: the 50 keV first-of-tie minloc with the class cap, the implicit-grid/index rejections, and the energy/increment formulas on a non-uniform grid.
